verdict.rationale: Cursor's Cloud Agents can be triggered directly from a Linear ticket or GitHub/Bitbucket PR comment, work in an isolated VM to build and verify changes (start dev servers, click through UI, run tests), and then open a pull request automatically (autoCreatePR) with attached artifacts (screenshots/videos/logs) for review — a full issue-to-PR pipeline documented across automations, service-accounts, and cloud-agent capabilities docs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence confirming this end-to-end flow reliably works in practice (only vendor docs cited), and no explicit worked example tying a GitHub Issue specifically (vs Linear ticket) through to a merged PR.
